title: Detect, Explain, Interpret: An End-to-End Benchmark for Time Series Anomaly Detection, Explainability and Interpretability
abstract: arXiv:2610.01168v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time Series Anomaly Detection has received increasing attention, driven by the growing availability of complex time series data. This surge has led to the development of numerous detection methods, as well as a variety of benchmarks aimed at thoroughly evaluating their performance. However, most existing detectors remain largely agnostic to domain context, overlooking explainability and interpretability. One of the main reasons for this gap is that current benchmarks primarily focus on detection accuracy, and only few of them evaluate spatial explainability. Moreover, no benchmark currently provides sufficiently rich semantic annotations to support the generation of human-understandable interpretations of anomalies. translated_title: 检测、解释、阐释：面向时间序列异常检测、可解释性与可阐释性的端到端基准测试
translated_abstract: 时间序列异常检测日益受到关注，这得益于日益增多的复杂时间序列数据。这一热潮催生了大量检测方法的发展，以及各种旨在全面评估其性能的基准测试。然而，大多数现有的检测器在很大程度上仍然对领域上下文不敏感，忽视了可解释性和可阐释性。造成这一差距的主要原因之一是，当前的基准测试主要关注检测精度，其中只有少数评估空间可解释性。此外，目前没有任何基准测试能够提供足够丰富的语义注释，以支持生成人类可理解的异常解释。为了解决这些局限性，我们推出了SHAD（Scality高维异常检测基准），这是一个包含215个多变量、高维时间序列的完全注释基准，这些数据采集自真实世界的分布式系统。
tldr: 本文提出了首个端到端的时间序列异常检测、可解释性与可阐释性基准SHAD，它包含215个来自真实分布式系统的多变量高维时间序列，并提供完整的语义注释，填补了现有基准无法支持人类可理解异常解释的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SHAD, the first end-to-end benchmark for time series anomaly detection, explainability, and interpretability, comprising 215 fully annotated multivariate high-dimensional time series from real-world distributed systems, addressing the gap in existing benchmarks that lack semantic annotations for human-understandable anomaly interpretations.
